summary.text: Jack Daniels is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 32 since April 24, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small-business owner, he is vice chair of the Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jack K. Daniels lives in Ohio and attended Kent State University and the University of Akron, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner, and he has been affiliated with the Manchester Education Foundation and the Portage Lakes Career Center School.
Republicans in the Ohio House of Representatives appointed Daniels to District 32 on April 24, 2024, to replace Bob Young (R).
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Transportation Committee and serves on the House Insurance, Small Business and House Ways and Means committees.
Djordjije Popovic (D) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
